description: This file contains implementations of functions for working with Avro data in PySpark, including from_avro and to_avro, along with a test routine.

methods.name: from_avro
methods.description: Converts a binary Avro column into its corresponding Catalyst value using a specified schema.

methods.name: to_avro
methods.description: Converts a data column into its Avro binary format, optionally using a specified schema.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs tests for the Avro functions, including environment setup and doctest execution.
